rationale: The plan fits a single ~condition model on all twelve samples, answers the omnibus question with an LRT against ~1 and the pairwise question with named Wald contrasts against an explicitly releveled control, with ashr shrinkage and BH within each contrast at 0.05, matching the reference; it does not subset to eight samples and it explicitly warns against reading an LRT hit as a treatment effect. The one soft spot is that it never states that the Wald contrasts require a separate Wald fit after the LRT run, so a reader could extract LRT p-values under contrast fold changes, and the outlier policy is flag-only without a rule for a shallow library. The filter (10 counts in 4 samples, the smallest group) and in-model normalization are correct and justified. Enrichment was not asked for; the specification (full stat-ranked list, tested-gene universe, named collections with releases, 15-500 window) is sound but adds unrequested scope, so it is marked down slightly. The report block is complete, with versions, contrasts, counts, per-contrast FDR statement, and the n=4 and gene-level-count caveats.
